cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says a law, decree or policy in force classifies government data or requires state data to be held in the country; the proposed Data Sovereignty Statutory Instrument is not yet in force.
cells.note: Reassessed under Bill's ruling of 2026-10-31 (messages-for-bill 60: a rule must include government or state data): POTRAZ's bar on hosting core banking systems abroad binds financial systems, not state data (ZWE-002). The minister's proposed Data Sovereignty Statutory Instrument for critical government data is a draft (ZWE-003), so stage 2; the national cloud's hosting of government platforms (ZWE-006, ZWE-001) no longer lifts the cell without a rule.
